description.en: Drag an airplane window shade to dim the cabin, hide drifting clouds and switch the surrounding profile between light and dark themes.
description.zh: 拖动舷窗遮光板，机舱随之变暗、云层被遮住，个人介绍同步切换明暗主题。

keywords: 舷窗 遮光板 明暗 暗色 主题 拖动 飞机 云层 弹簧 window shade airplane dark mode theme toggle cloud shader spring mjbarton_

useCases: 拖动飞机舷窗遮光板切换明暗主题
An airplane shade control with continuous ambient dimming
discovery.caveat: 主题仅作用于组件，通过回调显式接入宿主。WebGL2云层有Canvas2D降级；原HTML许可未核实。

source.implementation: The supplied HTML adapted to an isolated DOM/WebGL2 core with six native framework entries and the original Canvas2D sky fallback. Profile text remains demonstration content, and the component never changes the host document theme.
source.license: No separate source license was supplied or verified. Embedded Inter and JetBrains Mono fonts retain their SIL Open Font License notices.

notice.en: Source packages preserve the supplied material. Redistribution rights have not been verified.
notice.zh: 代码包保留提交的素材，再分发许可尚未核实。

instructions.en: Drag the shade down or tap the window to toggle themes. Focus the window and use Up, Down, Home, End, Space or Enter.
instructions.zh: 下拉遮光板，或轻点舷窗切换主题。聚焦舷窗后，可用上下方向键、Home、End、空格或回车操作。
